text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong gives clue that general election will likely to be held next year.
- Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong says Singapore Democratic Party's error defence falls short.
- Singapore Airlines announces first-half earnings up 7.2% to Singapore $560.5 million from surplus of $123 million from aircraft sales.
- German industrial giant Daimler-Benz and Temasek Holdings join forces to undertake joint ventures in Asia-Pacific region.
- Brussels Ameritech Corp confimrs reports it will consider taking larger stake in Belgium's main telephone company, Belgacom.
- Analysts assess impact of 1997 Malaysian Budget as good for financial and IT stocks, bad for marine stocks and generally neutral for broader market.
-Economists and dealers say Malaysian ringgit is expected to decline in near term.
- CM Telecom International is to use proceeds of its Hongkong $135.3 million Singapore listing to finance three telecommunications projects.
